# Component: persistence

Files: `src/persistence.ts` (319 lines). Criticality: **Core**.

## 1. Component Overview
Save format v6 as a sparse delta keyed by record id, a strict decoder that refuses anything that could replace a live game with nonsense, and an IndexedDB store with `current` + `backup` slots. [HIGH] (`src/persistence.ts:4-10`, `src/persistence.ts:151`, `src/persistence.ts:264`)

- Complexity: **Moderate**.

## 2. Features & Capabilities
| Feature | Entry point | Certainty |
|---|---|---|
| Sparse save: only fields differing from a fresh record, plus `seen`/`locked` | `src/persistence.ts:80-107` | HIGH |
| Strict decode + rebuild through a real `GameEngine` | `src/persistence.ts:151-262` | HIGH |
| Refuse any other version (no migration) | `src/persistence.ts:155-160` | HIGH |
| IndexedDB `lowbridge-first-slice` / store `saves`, keys `current` + `backup` | `src/persistence.ts:6`, `src/persistence.ts:269-271`, `src/persistence.ts:281-288` | HIGH |
| Load falls back to `backup` when `current` fails to decode | `src/persistence.ts:291-296` | HIGH |

## 3. Workflows & Behaviors
**WF-persistence:001 — Write** (`src/persistence.ts:299-316`): re-decode the new save (fail before touching storage) → in one readwrite transaction, copy the decodable previous `current` to `backup` (a damaged `current` is skipped so the good backup survives) → put `current` → resolve on commit, reject on abort. [HIGH]

**WF-persistence:002 — Load** (`src/persistence.ts:280-297`): read both slots → none: fresh game → try `current`, then `backup` (`recovered: true`) → both fail: throw the last error (main shows import / new-journey UI, `src/main.ts:44-70`). [HIGH]

**WF-persistence:003 — Decode** (`src/persistence.ts:151-262`): format + exact version → per-record items (unknown item keys refused; departed ids skipped) → world assembled, including any recorded fight (`src/persistence.ts:210`) → `new GameEngine(records, state)` recomputes derived fields → bank clamped to derived cap → active/waiting objectives re-validated against today's content. [HIGH]

| BR-persistence:005 | Waiting entries hold no progress; duplicates refused | Supporting | `src/persistence.ts:225-226` |

## 10. Legacy Warnings
- Literal `60` duplicates `EXP_PER_LEVEL` (`src/persistence.ts:189` vs `src/engine.ts:10`). [HIGH]
- The departed-id policy is applied to items only (see BR-persistence:003 vs :004 and `.ai/docs/issues.md`). [HIGH]
- The empty `catch` at `src/persistence.ts:309` is deliberate: it only skips backup rotation; the primary write still rejects through `onabort` (`src/persistence.ts:314`). [HIGH]
